note: Recall bench (2026-10-25): questions against Matt's own memory database (a read-only copy, RECALL_BENCH_DB), each with the ids of the memories that answer it. Scored by where the first expected memory ranks under the production hybrid search, for four ways of embedding a memory: the stored fact (current), title+fact, fact+source message, and the source message alone (what the old pipeline stored). Ids are those of Matt's desktop database on 2026-10-25; the file is a labs tool, not a product test.
